title: Inversion
src: Charlie Munger, after the mathematician Carl Jacobi
idea: Solve a problem backward. Ask how you would make it fail, then avoid exactly that.
apply: Before a project, list five ways to guarantee it fails. Remove each one from your plan.
remind: Ask how it fails. Then do not.
who: Aisha, twelve days from a product launch.

scenes.sub: How do we make it succeed? Vague answers.
scenes.nar: Aisha's team launches a new product in twelve days. The usual question, how do we make it succeed, gets vague answers.

items.x: Let one person hold all the knowledge

scenes.nar: So she flips it. How would we guarantee failure? Skip testing. Tell nobody until launch day. Let one person hold all the knowledge.
Then she turns each failure around. Test with five customers. Email the waitlist on Friday. Write a one page runbook.

items.x: Runbook fixed an issue in 10 minutes

scenes.nar: Launch day goes smoothly. Testing caught two bugs early, the waitlist showed up, and the runbook fixed one issue in ten minutes.
